t: Find useful spare parts in the cave and bring them to Elena Zimina.

Alright, let's get to work. Herbert is waiting for us.

We will explode no more doors! We don't need the whole place to collapse. This time we will do it my way. I have studied the security system of this complex, and I think I can assemble a device that will help us bypass it. Luckily, we are dealing with a prehistoric technology...

As I configure the main circuit board of the device, please, search this place. It looks like it used to be some kind of workshop, so most likely we will find something useful. Even simple buttons will do.

Come on, bring everything you find!
Once I accidentally fixed a ship reactor with a hairpin! The mechanic's face was priceless, haha!

I think that would be enough... With a configured board, it is just as easy to set up a device as to make a bomb!

And the result is much less messy. Last time you did it I had to wash down the dust for an hour! And what if I didn't have a shower? Ah, I was so angry with you!
Obtain seven mysterious spheres and bring them to Elena Zimina at the lower floor of the Mine.

Some little mechanisms are prowling around, but I don't understand what they are. Are they completely mechanical... or something else?

You know what's interesting? They have a small shining sphere, it's like it's their core or something. It looks just like the sphere that the creatures in the caves had! They are connected somehow, that's for sure.

If they are really Mechanoids, this sphere must be some kind of a battery. I think we should collect several samples since they are in our way.
Luville will kill me if we don't find anything interesting.

So... What has just happened?

I didn't understand anything. Did the sphere come alive? And it... grew a matter on itself? It created another Mechanoid? Or it wasn't a Mechanoid?

But how? I don't think machines can do things like that! Neither can living beings...

Maybe it's the final stage of the experiments conducted back at the Bestiary? Anyway, we shouldn't approach these spheres. Just crush them!
Find a way to the lower part of the Mine.

It looks like I will have to stay here. If they are smart enough, they will send troops and not just scouting squads. And when there are two enemy battle units under the same roof... Golases help us!

I will make sure they don't tear each other apart. We shouldn't rely on their rreason, eysh! This is not something good warriors are famous for.

You need to go on. This damn sphere can't be too far away. Keep your eyes on Zimina. And Herbert, if you find him. I don't like what is going on...

Go with honor, kylys! And be careful.
...The elevator's control panel reads that it is out of order. The elevator must be fixed first.
It sounds like the elevator started working.
Collect all the necessary parts at the lower floor of the Mine and fix the elevator.

All these mechanisms are parts of the elevator control system. If we fix them, we can probably make this thing work again. That's not an easy thing to do... We need to find a power supply for the control panel first. And also the moving elements are stuck fast, so we need to grease them.

We should look for something useful at the lower floor.
I wish Luville was here to help us!

What was that? Thanks Nezeb the ceiling didn't collapse!

As I can see, the elevator is fixed. Not quite as delicately as Luville would have done it, but at least it's working. Are you sure you fastened all the screws? And greased the gears? And checked the mana battery?

Alright, alright...
Go down to the technical floor of the Mine.

I'm afraid Murk will have to stay here. Now it's only me and you. Anything can happen down there. So, I might have no other chance to say it...

Your help means a lot for all of us. We wouldn't have made it to here without you! And you had no personal interest in that. But still you committed great feats - yes, I mean it! - in the name of our cause.

Thank you.

Alright... We have wasted too much time already. If that wretch had done anything to Herbert, as Nezeb is my witness, I will... Ah, she will regret it. Let's go!

I swear I will wipe up the floor with her! Alright, pull yourself together, Elena. There will be time for that...

It looks like the clone has set all the defensive systems of this part of the complex against us. The good news is, we have almost reached our destination - why else would this place be so intensely secured? The bad news is, I don't know how do we break through.

We will have to improvise.
Hack security systems of the Mine's technical floor.

From what I know of Imperial security systems, the access can be granted only when there are two persons with the required access level. So hacking them takes two. Don't worry, if I am right, I will just tell you what to do. If I am wrong... well, it won't be your fault.

So... Take that control panel. Don't do anything unless I tell you! We cannot fail. Not here.

Let's start!
Luckily, I stole the device that Herbert used to hack Amadeus. As far as I remember, you assisted him. So you have some experience in hacking, which is good.

I must admit it was one of the most impressive rescue operations in my life. And believe me, I have something to compare with. Where, in the name of Astral, did Elena get this gun? Alright, I will let women keep their little secrets. Why are you looking at me like that?

Ah, of course. I was finally disclosed. Believe it or not, but I was not going to keep it secret from you. Though I was expecting to tell you the truth under slightly different circumstances...

Who else knows? Zayan, of course. Maybe Murk suspects something, that wouldn't surprise me at all. Elena? Things are complicated with her... with us. She will tell you if she wants.

I wish I had more time to speak with you and explain everything. But I am afraid I don't.
Try to establish a contact with the Object.

So this Object - or the Source - lied in the heart of all this construction. You are looking at the "Gates", yes, the ones this complex was built for.

Local scientists thought that the Source was inanimate. Maybe, just a huge source of energy. Well, they were wrong. Whatever it is, it is alive. I am completely confused. The clone dragged me here, praising this creature, and promised to show her "ideal"... But as soon as she left, the Source helped me break loose!

It is definitely conscious. But what does it want? We should ask, I suppose.

The problem is, it doesn't speak with me. Maybe you will try? Something is telling me that your visions somehow attest to your ability to communicate with... the likes of it.

...The sphere is obviously responsive to approach. The sparks start tossing on its surface, the furrows rearrange. The Object which seemed solid before, now slightly shrank and then expanded again.

If one listens closely, a quiet and distant noise can be heard, resembling the wash of the waves.

...When you approach the sphere, you start feeling the familiar dizziness; your body grows numb and everything goes dark before your eyes. Another vision insistently wants to show itself. This time you manage to stay conscious.

This seems to be the only way the Object can communicate now. You should listen to what it has to say.

Wow... The same kind of visions? So, the Architects' artifacts have been right under our nose all the way, and we... The Object tried to contact you? I wonder, why?

If it foresaw everything, it means, it made us dance to its tune? Maybe it fell down there, to the bottom of the Mine, at its own will? Well, no, it doesn't add up... Well, it proves again that we should keep an eye on that creature.

This all is very interesting. It's just...
Repel the attack of the mysterious creatures.

I'm afraid we don't have time. The clone got what she wanted, after all - she held us just long enough to make sure we can do nothing to the portal. If we destroy it now, it may end up in a catastrophe. A really big one.

Something will spurt from there any moment now. Creatures like no one has ever seen before. We could run, but where? We wouldn't make it anyway.

I'm sorry I dragged you into that. If only we had more time, I would tell you many things. About Irdrich. About Charles. About the purpose of my presence here. But this all doesn't matter now.

I just want you to know... that I am sorry.

...The stone colossus does not react to the turmoil and stands still.

Still, it came to the rescue, when help was needed... Whatever its motives were.

As you approach the Object, your thoughts start tumbling, and then suddenly become surprisingly clear. You come to understand many events that happened on Ferris. Jigsaw pieces finally fall into their places. Only several blank spots are left.
Get final answers from the Object. Talk to Herbert de Vevre.

...Suddenly, the familiar sound - or is it noise? or a voice? - raises in your head. It looks like the Objects wants to communicate telepathically, but you cannot understand a word.

The Objects seems to realize that. The noise is going down, and dozens and hundreds of images flash in front of your eyes. It all happens within a minute, but it feels like hours.

You come to understand the Architect's language very soon. It is surprisingly primitive... or perfectly plain? It's hard to say.

One thing is clear: the Objects is trying to talk. And it is good, for you have way too many unanswered questions.
So have you talked to the Object?

What an interesting conversation. So, about that "Sculptor"... Do you believe it?

I think it is a little bit crazy itself. It's like there are two personalities in it - "him" and "them". Well, it is to our advantage to help "him" get away from "them".

It's good that it is trying to establish a contact with us. Its language is like a code. I hope it won't cause any side effects. Are you feeling well? That's great.

Well, with me it is slightly more complicated.
Talk to Marianne de Ardeur and settle the armistice between the Empire and the League.

Honestly, when I saw that the League sent its high prioress as the head of a battle mission, I couldn't believe my eyes. I didn't know what to think - did Aidenus lose his mind, or didn't the League realize the importance of these events?

But we just saw her in battle, and she could teach our soldiers a thing or two. I must admit, the Council's account on her is obviously scarce. But we will find out who is responsible for that later.

I suppose, you realize that the League and the Empire must act together. I entrust you, an honored member of our society, with the peacemaking mission. Go to Marianne and tell her we are ready to consider the armistice conditions.

"Ready to consider", are you? Well, it is the most sincere peaceful settlement that I've heard in many years. I am happy to be present here on this day!

What? No, that wasn't irony. It is an honor indeed!

We are ready to discuss the armistice. I hope it's not too late, and we still can repel the enemy.
Talk to Elizaveta Rysina and settle the armistice between the Empire and the League.

So, Rysina herself is here? How interesting... and disturbing. Well, we should have expected that - this allod preserves the secrets of the Empire from the times of Nezeb, so it is a paramount matter. I suppose that the fact that the Council knew nothing about Ferris wounds her pride. Her job is her life. She deserves respect, even though she is one of our greatest enemies.

This is important now, for now we have to sign up an armistice if we want to stand at least a tiny chance to beat our new enemy. This is a wrong time to cherish our pride. Please, go to Rysina and suggest our temporary cooperation. Remember to put it this way exactly! As far as I remember, Rysina has a high opinion of you, so you would be the best candidate to take up this diplomatic mission.

Temporary cooperation, is it? Well, it is acceptable. I would rather say, unavoidable under such circumstances.

We will consider your offer. Since you are Marianne's assigned secretary, you will be the ceasefire testifier. Don't take it amiss, but I will have to discuss the conditions with Marianne in person.
Go to the technical floor of the Bunker and speak with Elizaveta Rysina.

Alright, I'm not distracting you anymore! As far as I understand, you have a serious battle to fight. Too much technical information won't help you survive... I mean, help you win!

Marianne de Ardeur and Elizaveta Rysina arrived here together. I think leaving these two alone for a long time is not such a good idea. Don't you think so?

Now go! And good luck.
The Historians have little political importance for us, so you shouldn't be trying so hard for them. We have to figure out what to do with this damned portal.
Go to the technical floor of the Bunker and speak with Marianne de Ardeur.
What you are doing for the Historians is invaluable. Now when we are done on Ferris, we can think what to do next.

Formally, we have done our job. We found out where Tep had derived his power. The Object gave it to him, as it bestowed insanity on Negus Jeeg. It bestowed a perverted immortality on all the staff of the complex.

The only question that is left unanswered is - how? How does the Object do that? Who created it? How did it end up here? Don't you want to find the answer?

Watch out on our way down. It is possible that we are not coming back...
This Source is an incredible thing...

So, the expedition is coming to an end? Well, it was a fascinating adventure. At the bottom of the abyss, we found a way to... another world? To something infinitely distant from Sarnaut, which suddenly became very close? Just reach out your hand, make a step... And you are there. Dankin believed that the Source could become our path to a better life in a better place.

I must admit, I admire that man. Really. He had a divine power in his hands, and he chose to use to create a bright future for the whole world. And Negus Jeeg... was a pathetic minion. A madman who craved power and infamously wasted his brilliant wit. I despise him and feel ashamed that he once belonged to my people.

Still, Dankin almost destroyed this world when he let the Architects in. And Negus Jeeg was probably the one who saved Sarnaut from them. On Tep's order. I wonder if Tep ever knew of the Architects, but I doubt we will ever find this out.

So, that's the story of Ferris. You may draw any lesson you wish from it.
Read the research log of the Object and bring it to Yaver Gnostis in the mine.

...The log remained almost intact. Its pages, covered with loose handwriting, contain valuable information regarding the purpose of the Mine, and also some important information on the Object.

Here and there on the margins of the log there is a curious verbatim of the scientists' conversations. Among them, there is a dialogue between Vasily Dankin, the former head of the complex, and Negus Jeeg, the crazy Tep's minion who started all the trouble.

You should bring this to Yaver Gnostis. Herbert calls him "the keeper of secrets" of the Surveyors, so he can be entrusted with such an important information.
What an interesting place... You wanted something?

A log? Very curious. I was afraid I was going to have to search this place myself, but here is all the information I need.

This looks very promising. So the mine is just a huge pipe way for the safe opening of the portal! An interesting solution, though not the most elegant one. And now it is supposedly worthless since the Object was displaced.

If you find anything else, let me know. I am very short on assistants!
Collect 10 fragments of the report in the mine and bring them to Yaver Gnostis.

...Something weird has happened here. I can see heavy burns on the bodies of modified scientists. Their clothes are mostly burnt and fused to their skin, which then rotted and fell off. It happened so long ago it doesn't even smell in here. Only the horrible sight and strange papers scattered around.

We should take a look at them.
Yes? What is it? I'm very busy.

"Yesterday, on July 13, 965, a burst of magical activity was detected in the 15th module of the Source, which resulted in modification of the appearance and behavior pattern of the experimental lizard specimen #4, contained in the..."

Damned recondite language. I don't mind it, but sometimes you just need to get straight to the point, if you know what I mean. Here it goes:

"The animal attacked lab worker Voronina (henceforth, V.), who tried to neutralize it with a shock baton. Upon skin contact with the animal, V. experienced intense pain feelings. Her skin covering started turning into a dark blue mineral, resembling..."

Well, there is some logic in that. As we know from Negus Jeeg's journal, the Object could affect the bodies of the staff. But mass impact on so many people at once... That seems hardly possible. However, the virus could incubate in several bodies, and then cause the subsequent outbreak... An epidemic. The modification started as a usual disease. It quickly adapted and spread through the whole complex. They tried to burn it with fire...

Obviously, unsuccessfully. Thank you for this precious document.
Listen to Herbert's story and report to Yaver Gnostis.

Well, the main mission of our expedition was completed. Here somewhere the life of Herbert de Vevre comes to an end... died tragically, by the hand of a maddened clone. Or an Imperial agent. Or an unknown creature from another world. Anyway, no one will ever know the truth about neither Herbert nor Charles. I will take care of it.

I guess you want to know why I pretended to be a Historian. That's a long story... To keep it short, the source of Tep's power was haunting me, the biggest mystery of the world! So I had to change my personality. I thank Zayan - he believed in me, and I didn't let him down. I solved that mystery! Well, almost. But now the League and the Empire have to step in. This is not something an ordinary elf can handle.

Yes, I am afraid to hear the answer. And I have nothing to be ashamed of - now I have the one who fills my life with light and warmth. I will not give it away for any mysteries of history!
So little time, so much to do... Do you have any important news?

I must admit I never thought I'd discover such incredible things in this hole on the outskirts of the Astral! Just think of it! Another cloning technology, an otherworldly mineral, transmutation of living organisms... We are still studying the records of those scientists - luckily for us, they documented everything!

Some of the experiments deserve to be continued. Cloning, for example. From what Herbert says, I derived that the girl preserved a bit of humanity that she inherited from the prototype. A living being, sentient and conscious, deprived of a Spark! Zayan will be fascinated by this technology.

Thank you for all your efforts!

Well, everything is ready, checked and re-checked... Let's start! I can't wait anymore. I can't believe we are about leave this place.

Honestly, I'm not really sure it's such a good idea to reveal the frightening mystery of this lab to the world, but as elves say, fortune favors the daring!

Let's do it!

What in the name of Astral has just happened?! Who, tell me, who makes a sliding floor in a lab?!

Has anyone noticed how deep it was? And what was it down there at all? I swear I saw a blue light. And what if... No, I won't even think of it.
Fight the three Tungar champions - Tyk, Pyk, and Myk, and report to Maas-Tyna the Light-Footed.

Believe it or not, there are decent warriors among the Tungars, eysh! They will dare to duel you, and they will fight till their last brreath. They are the last hope of these savages. All Tungars are now hiding behind the backs of their champions.

They know that you are coming, so they are rready to face you armed to the teeth. The best warrior, the best hunter, and the best shaman. Defeat them - and the Tungars will scatter in terror! Will you do that, zoor?

But don't kill them, no! Show merrcy. The spirits say those champions might turn out to be useful. A true hunter doesn't spill blood in vain!
Grreat, kylys! It's even better than I'd thought. These three will help us move on, eysh! Now we don't have to fumble in the dark.
Defeat Tribe Chief Booka-Booka and report to Maas-Tyna the Light-Footed.

It's about time we beheaded the most stubborn Tungar on this allod. As I anticipated, chief Booka-Booka is not so esteemed in his trribe anymore. Tyk and Pyk now reckon you are their leader. Together with Myk they will help you in this fight. You must understand that their help is worth a lot, zoor?

But be careful. Booka is a really strrong enemy, eysh! He is brave and daring, like a bird who protects its nest from a lynx. When he was young, he mastered and saddled a wild yak! You know, Tungars are terrified of yaks. And as far as I know, he killed the previous chief and rightfully took his place. So are their traditions, ay-hya!

I really doubt that you can take him alive. This hunhurr definitely won't ask for mercy.
When Booka-Booka is defeated, the Tungar problem may be considered solved.

Excellent, eysh! The Tungars will finally get off our back without their barking chief. Of course, little groups of crrazy fanatics will keep on attacking us from time to time, but it will be no trrouble fighting them off.

But no more playing games, kylys. Our next enemy will be more serious.
Aho, friend! We're about to start a nice hunt!
Defeat ancient mammoth Toros and report to Maas-Tyna the Light-Footed.

That crreature that the Tungars worship actually exists, eysh! The ancient beast dwells in one of the deepest Northern caves. Myk told me that they call it Toros.

Ay-hya... I took it for a regular old mammoth at first. But the body of this beast is obviously possessed by some hunhurr, eysh! It can control the power of cold and wind. The Tungars bring it offerings and believe that they can help it live forever so that it can annihilate all their enemies. And you know what the power of faith can do, zoor?

You will have to eliminate not only the mammoth, but also that crazy Tungars' cult. Tyk, Pyk, and even Myk have agreed to help you, even though the thought of facing Toros scares them to death. Follow the example of their courage! Brace yourself and slay the monster!

Ferris has never seen a hunt like that, eysh!
Beware of his accomplices, kylys. Even the most ridiculous lunatics are dangerous.

We all anticipated his death. Can you feel that, too, zoor? As if it has become warmer. And brrighter. And I can breathe more freely. What if he was actually... a god? Or something like that. It's a shame we will never find that out.

But I'm happy with the fact that Toros is gone. One less danger, eysh!
Defeat giant Gastornis Curlew-Khan and report to Sergey Dozorin.

Alright, here is the deal.

They say, there is a rooster in every yard in Kanian villages. The Bestiary has its rooster, too. It's a Gastornis, actually. A giant bird, seen nowhere outside Ferris. It can't fly - that is why it is so frantic, probably.

Rest assured, it will try to eat you as soon as it sees you. You will be intruding its territory, after all. The worst thing is, there is no way you can get around it.

The good news is: this specimen is one of its kind. If you deal with it, you won't have to worry about Gastornises again.
I wonder how long it will run around when we chop its head off?
That chicken was stronger than I thought! How are you? Are you alright? Great. Now let's explore the Bestiary!
Get inside the Bestiary and talk to Sergey Dozorin.

One of our jaegers, Sergey Dozorin, sent me a message yesterday. He has found another entrance to the Bestiary. He has somehow activated a Portal in a cave in the Deadly Frostland. Tungars use that cave it in their pagan rituals.

I don't think you will be able to pass them unnoticed, like Dozorin did, but you always can fight your way through them. Maas-Tyna the Light-Footed in our first camp can show you the way.

The Bestiary might hide all the answers to our questions, so we cannot miss the opportunity to learn them. Gather your strongest allies and start exploring the mysteries of the Bestiary right now!
Greetings. What took you so long? Me and Baxter have been waiting for you. We are getting sick of the canned food!

Oh, you've heard about my old hobby? I think some ships in the port of Novograd are still moored with my chains. I had to make a living somehow back in the day...

You say you need a chain? I guess I can help you with that. Watch and learn!
h: Ask for help with crafting the chain

t: Finally! I thought we would have to stay in those frozen lands forever, lost in conjectures. I feel that we are close to very important discoveries!
Excellent! Wait a second, I'll charge the Mana Converter... Here you go! Runs like clockwork now. At least I hope so...

A crystal as the source of the mutation? It can't be!

Yes, I can sense that it radiates some energy, but I fail to recognize its nature. If it is magic, then it is really unusual. But I have no doubt that this crystal was extracted from the meteorite at the bottom of the lake and transported to the Bestiary. What does it mean? It means two things!

The first thing is, the crystal was the key subject of the scientists' research. Maybe the constant exposure to its radiation caused the unexpected consequences.

The second thing, we don't know for sure whether the experiment failed, or was successful. The Bestiary has been abandoned for too long, and we don't know whether the mutated animals were bred on purpose, or the mutation was a side effect.

You know... I think you should speak to someone who knows more about technology and magic than anyone in Sarnaut. To Catherina!
Defeat Havoc, the queen of Howling birds, and report to Sergey Dozorin.

For me, Bestiary is more of a hen house. There is another bird in the way, and this one is even larger. I suppose you've already seen Howling birds? Soon you will meet their queen.

Not much is known about Howling birds, or Roc birds. I only know that their females have particular magical abilities. They can control wind and cast lightning bolts! The oldest ones also can learn other kinds of magic. I bet this one can manipulate fire and shadows as well...

I really wouldn't want to be in your shoes right now.
I guess there won't be much left of this bird after it faces you. I wish I could stuff it afterwards!

That was a hot fight! Of course, I was watching you! By the way, beware of dust storms. I've got sand stuck everywhere...

So, we're done with the birds! Now we'll have to deal with some crawlers...
Defeat Rustle, the blind Cougar, and report to Sergey Dozorin.

Jaegers are taught that your ears and nose must be as important to you as your eyes. Still I need Baxter to smell things out for me! Ah, this dog is too smart...

Alright. The deeper we go, the worse it gets. All animals inside of the Bestiary seem to be covered with some strange stone shell. Many of them are already dead, but the survivors... have turned into real monsters. Take that huge cougar. It keeps prowling around the complex and sniffing something out... I kept watching it for some time, and I realized that it had went completely blind because of the mutation. You think it makes it weaker? Oh, no. It sees with its ears and nose just fine!

If you want to get deeper into the complex, you need to defeat it first.
This creature can hear even the slightest rustle...

As Pridens say, that was one fine hunt! You can be proud of yourself - this was not just a fight with a huge cat. It's a proof that mutated animals can be killed, which is great! Now we know that we can gain control over the Bestiary and unravel its secrets.
Defeat Thunderer, the experimental yak, and report to Sergey Dozorin.

Remember how Tungars were scared of yaks? I wish I could see their faces if they ran into the experimental specimen from the Bestiary.

I managed to get into the archives of the Bestiary and read something about the researches that were conducted in the year of the incident. Meet your enemy - the Thunderer project; an attempt to turn a yak into an energy producing machine. As the documents state, the attempt was failed. But I've seen the yak with my own eyes, all buzzing with lightning bolts and electric sparks!

I think that the mutation somehow affected its abilities.

I wonder if the mutation was a result of an accident, or those scientists found a way to stimulate the mutation artificially?.. Anyway, we will have to kill the monster before it becomes too dangerous.
I wonder if one can dodge a lightning bolt. Can you try it? Please?

Well... That Thunderer is a bright individual for sure.

We are on the right way. Baxter refuses to go on, and he's a smart dog, though cowardly. And I can feel that we are very close to the source of the mysterious disease.
Defeat Specimen, discover the source of the mutation, and report to Sergey Dozorin.

You know, I remember what you told about your vision... And I come to realize that what you saw was the heart of the mutation. Though you probably don't remember that.

There is a dead zone in the far end of the Bestiary. Animals and birds keep away from it. My dog refuses to go there, and honestly, I don't really want to myself. But I'm afraid I have to...

There must be a cave in the depth of the complex. Whatever hides in there, it conceals the final answers to our questions. You will have to fight the thing that has destroyed the whole Bestiary. I've already called for the expedition technicians - they are bringing all the necessary equipment - hovering platforms, turrets, explosives... So you will also have to guard the staff and the inventory!

Just try not to die in there, alright? I'm sure we will need you help in the future. Good luck!
The expedition members call your next enemy the "terror of the Bestiary"...

A crystal? A single stone deranged all the animals in the area and turned them into monsters? Unbelievable!

Well, I will leave this mystery to someone else. Me and Baxter have better things to do. Drink some Prowls' brew, for instance!

You are good indeed! I've heard a lot about you. Now I am wondering who was more of a beast - those defeated creatures... or you?

Never mind. It's time to have a drink!
Show the shard, obtained in Specimen's lair, to the Surveyors.

Could it be that this plain stone have caused all the mischiefs of Ferris? Strange mutations, deranged security systems, perished scientists - all because of a small piece of crystal matter? Unbelievable...

We should ask the Surveyors about the crystal and the energy that it is emitting. Maybe together we will find the answer to this riddle!
What has brought you to my chamber? You want to relish your triumph one more time and mock the unfortunate sorceress?

I'm sorry, there is nothing else I can do. Captain Krivov is dead, all my scientific researches have turned to ashes and a pile of scorched metal, all thanks to you. No, no, I'm not blaming you - I was unaware of what I was doing and brought the world to the brink of destruction. But I cannot help you now.

If you don't mind, I will keep the shard and continue my research. If this is how it affects both living flesh and metal, I need to find a way to use to fight the cursed Leper. What if it is our only chance?
Destroy the security Mechanoids and report to Herbert de Vevre.

As you already know, this place is mostly secured by Mechanoids. They do it pretty well - the scientists have been long gone, and they are still protecting the complex! But what if the Mechanoids were affected by the modifying crystal, too? Would they continue following the instructions, or would they turn against their owners? This is a tricky question, and we will have to answer it.

The modified Mechanoids that secure the laboratory are blocking our way. I have no clue what they are capable of. It seems that neither elves nor ZIT Headquarters have ever seen this kind of technology. I wish we didn't have to destroy them.

Come back as soon as you deal with them.
The construction of the robots suggests that they were designed to operate in pairs. Though occasionally they can turn the fire against each other.

I will ask our technicians to find out as much as possible about these Mechanoids. There may be many more mechanical modificants like these ones that we will have to deal with. I will keep you informed.

Enough with the talking. Let's get to work.
Find Herbert de Vevre in the lab complex on Ferris.

So, our ways are parting. You need to go with the expedition, and I'm staying in the Bestiary. I like the place, you know.

The most interesting things must be waiting for you in the heart of Ferris! Stick to Herbert. He is a smart and reliable guy.
Ah, here you are! Shall we begin?
Eliminate the clone of Herbert de Vevre and report to Herbert de Vevre.

Our most dangerous enemy at the moment is my clone, created by that crazy Arisen. He knows everything that I know. He can do things that I can only imagine. Taking into account his modifications, it is way too risky to let him live.

We have no choice... Kill him, please. He will do anything he can to get to me. I know this because... I know myself.

May your hand be steady! Remember, he is not me!
What would I do if I had to face a whole battle squad? I would use a powerful combat mechanism...

Yes... I saw it. I connected to the lab surveillance system while you were away. A severe fight. My clone turned out to be much stronger than I thought. Can you imagine what an army of the likes of him could do? And Zimina's clone is still somewhere out there!
Defeat Negus Jeeg and report to Herbert de Vevre.

Well... Now I can see all the sections of the complex. The damned maniac, who has created our clones, knows that, and sooner or later he will try to take over the control. We can't waste time! We need to kill him now!

I will show you the way... Hurry up, before he strikes first! Be careful - you don't know what to expect from him. There is nothing more dangerous than a mad fanatic!
He may play one of his tricky games on you. Be careful.

Dead? Oh... I know, one shouldn't rejoice on someone's death, but still I'm glad you put an end to his wretched existence.

We have already started studying the laboratory archives. The crazy man's name was Negus Jeeg - he used to be the head of the complex. He took the post after his predecessor died in a "production accident" in the Bestiary.

I feel like we are missing something very important in this story...
Ask Semer Hatshah to translate the journal and bring it to Herbert de Vevre.
...That's an interesting book! It looks like Negus Jeeg wrote these notes - they are all in Hickut. Semer Hatshah can translate them.
Have you found anything in the laboratory?

Well... finally the pieces fall into their places. Negus Jeeg was a Tep cultist, who was in charge of the whole complex. Unbelievable... But what happened next? How did that "Object" make him turn against his master? What is "perfection"? What is the Source?

I feel that whatever the answers to these questions are, we won't like them. I'm starting to think that it would be better for us to forget about Ferris, like the Empire did once.

January 11, 964

"The sudden death of Vasily Dankin has led to my appointment as the Head of the Research Complex. My little game has resulted in my full victory even earlier than I could imagine. Now all the staff are pawns in my hands... and Tep's hands. Soon their Sparks will follow that of Dankin. Soon. But not now. For now, I need them."

...

March 26, 964

"A Council agent has personally arrived to Ferris to supervise the development of the new ship prototype. I had no other choice but to demonstrate him the efficiency of the experimental ship reactor... Too bad he won't be able to tell anyone about it - there's just a handful of dust left of him. The Empire will have to cope without its new ships. Tep does not want the League to fall... I've just sent the schemes of experimental Mechanoids to my associates."

...

September 3, 964

"The Object seems to be hiding more mysteries than the Great Mages could have ever imagined... and neither could have Tep. Beyond all doubt, this is a source of a great power. I am finally on the right track."
h: Read the notes on Negus Jeeg's appointment as the Head of the Research Complex

t:
April 11, 965

"I've heard Skrakan had found a way to fight demons. Now when all the eyes of the world are watching him, my hands are free. During the last year, I have gradually replaced all the members of the Gates research team. Now I can trust most of them, and the rest are just expendables - orcs, mostly. We don't have much time. The next few weeks are going to define the outcome of my operation."

...

April 18, 965

"The Object is barely responding to its surroundings. We keep recording weak splashes of energy, but still know too little about what is inside of it - a magical life form? An ancient mechanism? One of the "expendables" stated that he saw a weird light coming out of the Object at 4 a.m. on April, 15. We took note of his words and eliminated him before he had time to tell anyone else. (Reminder: assign writing an obitual.) We don't have the right to risk."

...

April 19, 965

...Another piece of paper is attached above the page. It must be a fragment of another Object research log. The researcher's hand-written notes cover a printed text.

"Inspection record #45. Numerous micro cracks have appeared on the surface of the Object (caused by the internal pressure. Of what?) On closer inspection, a dim blue light can be seen in the cracks, flashing at 36.3 second intervals (the color keeps changing within blue and green spectrum, depending on the surrounding noisiness). The interval slowly reduces (to 35.1 seconds in 9-hour observation). The Object produces a low humming and slightly vibrates, but does not respond to external irritants. Despite the obvious burst of activity, its temperature does not change and remains at the indoor level. All our attempts to heat or cool the Object were failed (try the experimental ship cannon?). End of record."

...

May 1, 965

"An undesired accident happened. While I was away, the Object came alive and tried to "make first contact", as Sarang Sargass put it. During 30 minutes, the Objects was producing series of low sounds, which became "progressively melodic and questioning" (?). The process started at 11:47 a.m., when the interval between the flashes, according to our calculations, had to come down to zero. After the supposed contact attempt, the blue light faded. The vibration and the humming stopped. The Object is giving no signs of activity."
h: Read the notes on the Object research, dated by 965

t: Kill Reaper and report to Elizaveta Rysina.

The portal will open again soon. I can feel strong magical disturbances around it. It is obvious that the time has come, and we cannot wait anymore.

Frankly, I do not trust the Sculptor, and neither should you. His allegiance and motives are still questionable. He will help us enter the Architects' world, but he himself should remain here.

If what he says is true, then the first enemy we will face will be the guard of the portal. I don't think he will approve of our determination to destroy his precious Passage.

Let's do it!
Get ready. Who knows what will crawl out of there.

It was... tiresome. We cannot underestimate these creatures if we want to survive in here.

Watch out. It will only get worse.
Kill Reaper and Guard of the Passage and report to Marianne de Ardeur.

I'm afraid we don't have much time. Our charms are getting weaker with every second. The portal will be opened again soon, and then even the Sculptor won't help us close it again. Our only chance is to try and break into the Architects' world and seal it from the inside.

I know this sounds very difficult. I believe in the Light's power, but I do realize that any power has its limits. I cannot even imagine the place we are going to. Does it have the same physical laws? Will we even survive it? The Sculptor says, "our organisms should be functioning as usual", but I cannot completely trust such an odd creature.

Anyway, we don't have a choice! We will enter the portal together and put an end to this threat. In the name of Light!
Get ready. Light knows what kind of creature is hiding in there.

Oh... we barely made it. I knew it would be tough, but this thing turned out to be much stronger than I expected.

What is going to be next?
Reach the Cascade, the Hive Commander, and defeat him.

I don't like this space. It looks huge, but still it's too small for a battle. And I also get that weird feeling that... Ah, never mind.

I think we need to get up that rise. We cannot go anywhere else from here - the elven prioress is not that good at opening portals, I guess. Though I cannot blame her - our usual magic seems to be working unpredictably here.

Alright, let us not waste time. Let's go! Whoever stands in our way will regret it!

Well, I assume the Architects will soon head this way, and they will be much stronger that those two that we saw.

But I am already starting to enjoy this. The more of them show up, the sooner we finish this.
Reach the Cascade, the Hive Commander, and defeat him.

An odd feeling... Like darkness is condensing around us - invisible, intangible, even unhostile. But my skin crawls. Just look at this place - we have nowhere to retreat if we have to. Everything here subjects to alien laws which we will hardly ever fathom. We don't have the time for scientific surveys. Now we only have to stay alive...

But we should keep up our spirits anyway! Otherwise, even our faith is useless. No Light can save weak souls!

Come on! Let's find the source of this power and fight it!

The darkness has gone. It got easier to breathe... Can you feel it?

What a strange creature. At first, I sensed no aggression, but then... Well, it reminded me of Kanian children who cut off mice tails and set ant-hills on fire. Just to see what happens next. The creature was definitely studying us.

Whatever it was, it's gone. Let's move on.

Can you feel it? Well, why would you - you're not as experienced in psionicism as I am. Even my expertise is not sufficient to fully comprehend the situation.

Well, I tried to read the minds of these creatures, and I only could hear the same thing. Their minds seem to be... connected somehow. Their are not just acting as a whole. Their think as a whole. And the more of them there are, the louder and the more precise their thoughts are. What they are thinking about? Well, I will tell you later. This doesn't matter right now.

The point is, now the Architects' thoughts are so loud I cannot get them out of my head! I feel the approach of something... colossal!

Well done! I have never seen you in action before. Now I can see that the stories were true. But let's get back to the Architects.

Their peculiar mindset and their ability to change their bodies so easily suggests that probably there are no "Architects" - there is just one Architect. A single consciousness, distributed among many bodies that keep changing, fusing and falling apart, which only strives to reach the perfect Order? What if this is what the Sculptor meant? If it is so... well, that's too bad.

First there was a Guard, who wanted to drive us out of this world at any cost. Then there was a researcher, who wanted to learn as much as possible about us... I'm still trying to figure out what is it the Architects want from us. What is their mission? And what's most interesting, how do they think?

Look at the way they fight. No one of them stands aside. They don't just help each other in battle - they complement each other. The attacks never cease. The defense is almost impeccable. When we advanced, the all reacted at once, they regrouped and retreated simultaneously. When we were backing off, they intensified their onslaught.

"They don't have personal thoughts. They are all part of the same process and the same will." So the Sculptor said, and now I am starting to see what he meant. And I sure thing don't like it...

So it is true. They can actually fall into multiple different creatures... Or assemble into a monstrous construction. What kind of a living being is capable of that? If you think of it, how many Architects there actually are? We thought there were millions of them, but what... what if we've been fighting just one Architect?

It seems to me that we don't realize what our enemy is. If it is its normal state, are there any limits to its possibilities at all?

So, Locus... That's something new. I can feel him squeezing my head... My thoughts stumble and I can barely move. It looks like my weapon was turned against me... Not bad, not bad.

I am too exhausted to continue fighting... If I can't trust myself, I better stay here and help you in every possible way. The prioress is of very little use right now, too. Well, at least now it is clear why the Sculptor refuses to go here.

Now go and disassemble that monster! Its spawns are threatening our world, and that's why it will have to die! Me and Marianne will make sure nothing gets in your way.

Go!

Damn it! I can't believe we swallowed the bait so easily! And I was expecting it, I was ready... Nezeb knows, if we had more time, I'd make him regret the day when he found his so-called personality. He can't imagine what I can do with his mind!

Enough with that. I'm sure I will have a chance to take revenge.
Speak to Yasker in his Tower.

You made it! Almost safe and sound... I must admit I am surprised.

Are you still thinking about that nasty thing? Forget about it! Whatever those Architects thought of themselves, they've just lost. And we only attacked with a small squad! Imagine how easily we would have crushed them with a whole army. And still we should bear them in mind. What if we have to face them once again?

You did a great job and you should be proud of yourself! Now it's the time to tell Yasker - and it's better to do that in person before I draw up a report. Go to him. I will stay on Ferris for a little while. The Empire still has a lot do here. We cannot let all this precious information fall into the League's hands!

It looks like people will remember my reign as the time of great convulsions!

So, the Architects, creatures from another world. Of course, I suspected that Sarnaut was not the only miracle of the universe. And I certainly didn't expect every miracle to be friendly.

I will take notice of that. As soon as we have another potential enemy, we better reconsider the distribution of our forces. But anyway, I don't think the Architects will recover after such a devastating defeat any time soon. As far as I understand, it took them more than fifty years to establish a passage between their world and Sarnaut, and this, too, was a result of a sequence of incredibly stupid decisions. We are not letting it happen again.

On behalf of the Empire, I thank you! You have committed a great deed. Now enjoy your well-deserved rest and try to avoid expeditions like that one in the future. Who knows what other dirty secrets you can dig out and what forces you can disturb?..

Frankly speaking, I am not a big fan of landscapes, but... this world is beautiful in its own way. It has its cold and magnetic charm... And this creature is extraordinary in its... fidelity.

I don't feel very well. I could use some rest, but here it is an unattainable luxury. I am afraid if I come closer to Locus, I... I'm sorry, but this time I can only help you with a blessing. This placing is starting to affect me in a bad way...

Go! Fight, and remember - the fate of our world is in your hands. Me and Elizaveta will come to the rescue if we feel that Locus is growing weaker. But before that, we will stay here and try to hold the onslaught of the Architects. May the Light guide you!

Well, everything worked out. I could blame the Sculptor for treachery, but what's the use of that? Obviously, we shouldn't have trusted him from the very beginning. He is an alien to us.

I must admit I was hoping that now that he'd lived in solitude, we wouldn't turn his back on us. But everyone makes mistakes, and I am not an exception.
Meet with Aidenus in his tower.

I suppose we are done here. Don't let the Sculptor cloud your triumph! You have just committed a great feat. Your greatest feat, probably.

I hope our victory puts a period to this story. I will hope and pray for this... Every day! Can the Architects return, now that we have destroyed the Passage? I'm afraid, nobody knows this now. So there is no use in worrying!

I have to decide what to do with the Historians and Ferris. The Empire's presence makes things more complicated. I don't think they are eager to share their secrets. However, I can handle this. Now you should go to Aidenus as soon as possible. He's the one who can tell us what to do.

So here is how it comes out. The Cataclysm has taught us nothing! We continue to play with forces that are beyond our understanding! First Nezeb with his vain urge, now Zayan with his tireless researches... Ah, it least this time it ended well.

So, the Architects, the uninvited guests from beyond-the-edge. As Tensess said, everyone is given trials according to their strength. This time those creatures met a rebuff. If they come again, we will handle them, one way or another. But would they dare to? Now we will keep an eye out for them!

I thank you for your great deed! You saved not only the League, but whole Sarnaut. You cannot imagine how proud I am to have such a hero in our ranks!
Meet Herbert de Vevre in the Testing hall of the laboratory and help him study the project documentation.

Oh, this is so interesting! Everything remained the same as it was half a century ago, only covered with dust and mold. I'm sure the things we will learn here will lead us to a scientific breakthrough. We will open a new chapter of Sarnaut's history! Science and magic, working hand in hand - what can be more beautiful? Herbert thinks so, too!

By the way, he wanted to see you. He is in the testing hall. Go to the second floor and walk down the corridor. Watch out! Who knows how many wicked creatures are still hiding there?
We are at the doorstep of a great discovery!
O Tensess! I won't get through all these papers in a month!

Obviously, we are facing a source of a tremendous unknown power. No wonder Tep wanted to acquire it. But why did he leave Ferris? Why didn't he take the Object? What has transformed the scientists? Why has no one ever heard of the "Gates" Project? There are so many questions...

We need to study all the records! The scientists must have kept logs and made reports. We need to find out what our predecessors knew to keep surveying!
Go to the Central Laboratory Hall and talk to Luville de Ardeur.

Could you please go back to the central hall and call for Luville? Together we can go through these piles of papers much faster. And tell Elena and Murk to search other rooms of the complex. I'm sure there is a lot of information left that our scientists will find extremely valuable. We need to make sure it doesn't fall into the wrong hands...
What happened? Why did the alarm go off? Have you pushed any buttons?
Help Elena Zimina and find out why the alarm went off.

Wait... The alarm didn't go off in the testing hall! It went off in the wing where Elena went!

What did she do?! I told her, walking around the laboratory alone is pure madness, but you know how stubborn she is! She didn't even let Murk come with her.

Hurry, find out what happened there! If it is serious, come back and call for us right away!
What is going on? Where is Elena?

What happened?

Damn it! Elena... I knew we couldn't leave her alone for a second.
Meet Murk at the entrance to the East wing.

Damn it! The Mechanoids have gone crazy, Elena has fallen through the floor... I hope she is fine.

We can't just leave everything and go looking for her. What if someone comes across this ancient piece of iron, and it chops their head off?

You and Murk have worked together a lot, so I think you can handle this. Go to the East wing and look for Elena. Now!

Huh... Don't you think this all has already happened before, zoor? Elena gets into trouble, and we come to the rescue. If she is alive, I will tie her to the stairs in the central hall and leave her there till the end of the expedition, eysh!
Go with Murk to the Eastern part of the laboratory, find Elena Zimina, and return to Herbert de Vevre.

Get ready and go to the East wing. I will catch up with you - I want to take a look at the evacuation scheme. I hope Elena wasn't hurt, eysh!

Crrazy scientists... I swear on my ancestors, I would rather go to a scaled gnawer's lair, armed with a fork, than to this abandoned shrrine of scientific wisdom!
Don't waste time! Elena may be hurt or unconscious. She needs your help!

What took you so long? Elena's been back for 10 minutes! How did you miss her?

What happened? Elena acts... strangely. She didn't tell us anything, just took the thing that controls Mechanoids and went away. As far as I understood, she tried to use it to control the Mechanoids that were activated by the alarm.

...

What? Elena is not Elena? Are you out of your mind?
Follow Elena to the West wing of the Central Labratory.

Elena has been cloned? I can't believe that!

Are you sure? It sounds just too unbelievable. Why would anyone clone our Surveyor? She hasn't done it herself, has she?

Oh, demons... She took the control device! If it was not Elena, we are in trouble! We need to find her and find out who she is... or what she is!

Faster, to the West wing! Follow me!
Go ahead! We don't have much time! We need to stop Elena before she's done something terrible!
Here come the dear guests! Haha!
Defeat the Mechanoids in the right order and enter the next room of the laboratory.

Haha... We have uninvited guests here! I want to play a game with you! A game of... riddles!

Here is the first one:

What comes after the rain?

If you give the right answer, your wish will come true. If not, then mine will, haha!
The screen is empty and silent.
Do you like my game? Hahaha!
Destroy four acid dispersers and enter the next room.

So many years... I've been alone for so many years! But now I have you, haha!

I have developed a game theory. It is brilliant, I swear! It says, I always win, haha! You are given the honor to prove this theory on practice.

According to my supposition, a white mouse can count to five. But you are not mice, so I hope you can count at least to four. If you can't, then it's your problem!
The screen is empty and silent.
Excellent! You are smarter than rats, but still not smart enough for me! I have comprehended the meaning of what those pathetic worms called the Object, haha!
Complete another trial of the crazy scientist and enter the next room.

According to my game theory, every game is based on the possibility of choice. The choice can be either random, or intended. The choice can be made with either your mind, or, as you say it, with your heart. Now we will see if it is true!

Your friend is contained in a vessel. The second vessel, as you can see, is empty. To go to the next room, one of you has to take the vacant place. What will happen to them? That's a good question! Maybe, they will die. Or maybe they will regret not dying sooner, haha!

So, are you going to flip a coin, or make a deal? The choice is yours. Let's continue the game!
I think this Elena is the original one. I'm not sure though. But am I the original? I hope so. These games are getting way too far!
What are you doing here? What am I doing here?!
Reach the psychopath's shelter and find out what he wants from the Surveyors.

Enough with the games! I don't know what this psychopath wants with us, but he's not going to get it!

Let's go! I swear I will get that monster and beat the Spark out of him, together with all his knowledge about this complex. I'm sure he can tell a lot about the experiments that were conducted here!
I thought you and Herbert went to the West wing to search for Elena. What are you doing here, zoor?
Ah-hya, I've been worried! I can tell by your looks that something bad has happened, zoor?

You say there are now two Elenas and two Herberts, zoor? Once I drrank too much cactus infusion and saw two suns and listened to the stars... But you are being serious, eysh!

I don't know who Negus Jeeg is, but while you were away, I found the scheme of the lab. The only exit from the West wing is through the lower floor, and there are no portals or doors. So our enemy is locked in there, unless he can walk through stone.

Elena looks puzzled, by the way... I wonder what's on her mind, zoor?
Talk to Elena. She looks worried, eysh!
I'm sure that when we get to that scientist rat, we will find out a lot of interesting things. Murk said that he can make even the stones talk!
Oh, my head... I think my decision was a little too hasty.
I still can't believe in what happened. That freak stole my body, stole my memory... He stole me from me!

I think we should go down and try to capture the crazy Arisen, and as for our clones... I think it would be the best to destroy them. Clones are unnatural! I almost lost my mind when I saw myself!

I wonder how did that maniac learn to clone. Clones, Mechanoids looking like Tep's servants... That's too much for an Imperial lab, don't you think? The Object really bothers me. We need to find out as much as possible about it, and to do so, we need to get to our mad experimenter.
Talk to Yasskul Tau, chief physician of the health resort.

People say you won't stay here for long. Nezebrad wants to welcome the hero of the Empire!
But first you have to meet the most important person of our resort, Chief Physician Yasskul Tau. He is like a father to us.
Find the main building - there's a fountain in front of it. There you'll find him.

I've been waiting for you.
Now, where is your medical history?
Beat three combat dummies to prove that you are in an excellent shape, then report back to Yasskul Tau.

So, what do we have here?
Aha... I see... interesting...
You know, I cannot discharge you from the resort until you prove that you are in good health and ready to take up your duties.
Let's start from the beginning: physical training. There are several combat mannequins at the Western building. ZIT engineers have tweaked them so that any impact is registered and analyzed. Beat these dummies into the next week! We'll see how strong you are and if you are ready for more tests.
Medicine is the most exact science. The slightest mistake sometimes makes you pay a price.

The results are quite good...
You have passed this test successfully!
Gather 3 bunches of Cowberries along the walkway and return to Yasskul Tau.

Let's proceed.

The second test allows us to check your attention and motor function.

I guess you've already noticed cowberry bushes growing along the walkway. The berries are just starting to ripen, and it's not that easy to find them. But if you have a keen eye, you can get at least one berry from a bush! But don't expect that to happen often.

Pick 3 cowberries for me, if you can... Beware of bumblebees, they sting! Although we can cure that as well.
Noticing slightest details is a key of survival in this world!

Excellent results. Congratulations!
I wonder why you are so eager to leave my resort?
Kill 2 Spark Elementals and 2 Water Elementals. Report to Yasskul Tau.

The final test will check your combat alertness.
There are Water Elementals at the pond, behind the buildings to the east, and Spark Elementals wandering to the south. Defeat them using your skills and abilities. Prove us that you are ready to withstand the dangers of the outside world!
I'm sure the elementals are not too strong for you.

You've completed the third test!
Not bad!
Find Knot the Forester and ask him about Twelve Great Martyrs.

The last thing you have to do before you leave is obtaining the strength of your Patron.
Have you ever heard of the Martyrs? During the Cataclysm, twelve Great Mages managed to prevent the destruction of Sarnaut. They gave their lives to hold back the Astral. People call on the powers of their spirits ever since.
If you are going to fight stronger enemies, you have to undergo a special rite and learn who your Patron is.
On the Astral Coast, southwest from here, you will find shaman, Knot the Forester, who will help you to obtain a Patronage.
Come here, don't be afraid. I won't bite!
Disperse Astral Dust, kill the demon and return to Knot the Forester.

When you disperse this essence, hundreds of winds will start to roar. Don't be afraid, stand firm and listen - the Martyrs will talk to each other to decide whose power fits you better.
Know that a demon will appear to prevent you from seizing the power. Kill it mercilessly to complete the rite.
You can't have too much power, can you?

The rite is complete. Remember, now you have a special ability - Martyr's Salvation. It helps to regain your powers quickly. You can appeal to your Martyr at any time, as long as you have drops of mirra to spend. I happen to have a few - here, take these. When you run out of mirra, you can buy more from the Servants of the Light.
You will uncover new abilities later, along with the higher levels of Patronage.

Congratulations, you have passed the final test! Get back to Yasskul Tau. Chief Physician will now discharge you.
When you get to the capital, visit the Astral Quarter. My fellow orcs will be glad to see you...

I can see you have the Patronage now.
Good for you.
Use the pass at the underground station to get to Nezebgrad and meet Oleg Pravdin in the City Council at the Old Square.

So, the time has come for you to leave. Many heroes have visited my resort. I'm so proud when I read about their achievements in newspapers, because I took part in their training. I hope one day I will read a story about you, too.
You can get to Nezebrad via the underground route. Here, take this pass. Find major Oleg Pravdin in the City Council, he's already made an inquiry on you.

So, this is how the hero looks like... Hmm.
We were waiting for you. I bet Yasskul Tau made you going through his tests, didn't he? The guy is out of hand... Anyway, now we need to understand what has happened to "Invincible".
Speak to Kuar the Sage at the Forgotten Temple.

We can't stay here - the pirates will soon return from the dead. I need to get to Agrus as fast as I can, so it would be best for me to go alone. I'm quite skilled at traveling unnoticed - being caught by those pirates was just an unlucky blunder.
I'll meet you at the heart of the temple where Agrus is. Please make your way there quickly - it's a matter of great importance. I can't tell you more, but I give you my word as a Demon Hunter that if you help me heal Agrus, you won't regret it!
Go along the path to the north and you'll eventually find the ancient June ruins that make up the temple. I'll being waiting for you next to Kuar the Sage, a wise draconid priest. Speak to Kuar to learn more about the situation.
Will told me about you. I believe the draconids could truly use your help.
Talk to Agrus to learn how to help him.

Will brought Soliskar's Amulet to help Agrus. Great Dragon can talk to you. You return me my power... I share it with you.
You want... Patronage? You call it so? Kha-kha...
You sorry my laugh. You not know so much the world you live... But Power is Power! Even if you give different name.
Go to Agrus. Talk to him. Do what he says. Then you become stronger. Then you get Patronage, kha!

Come closer, mortal... Closer... Closer...
I can feel you. You want to obtain a new level of Power. To earn... Patronage...
If you help me... I will help you.
I give you a word of a Great Dragon! Such promises cannot be broken.

Use Ancient June Ruins to fly around the island. During the flight use the Orb of Dark Flame to curse 6 nodes of Astral shards. Complete the flight on board of the pirate ship and talk to draconid Grungor.

Restoring my power is a part of your task. First of all, you have to cook the sweetest dish in the world.
I am talking about vengeance! I won't be able to lead normal life knowing that my offenders, those mocking pirates, will resurrect and continue laughing at me! They must die forever!
Damned Tensess... Because of his sacrifice your kin cannot die!
But it doesn't matter... You will do what I say, and when the payback time comes, nothing will resurrect those pirate thieves.
I am giving you an ancient artifact, Orb of Dark Flame. Be careful with it! It possesses huge powers. We will use just a small bit of them.
Use the Ancient June Ruins behind my wings to fly around the island. There will be 6 nodes of Astral Shards. You must approach each and activate the orb. I will give you a signal to activate the artifact. Don't be afraid of what happens next! The power is meant to hurt my enemies, not you! The island will be covered with a shroud of Darkness. Not a single pirate Spark will break through to get into Purgatory!
Your flight will end on board of the pirate ship. Look for Grungor there. He failed to do what he meant to... But you will accomplish his mission! The Draconid is still alive, I can feel it... Even though I have been captured by pirates.
Go now! I am exhausted... Do what you must.

You burned astral shards with dragon fire?..
You are not pirate then... Shame on me! And the Great Dragon already knows about my fault...

Say nothing! I understand the Great Dragon despise me for weakness...
I not only disobey his order - I could not kill myself! Shame.
Find pirate captains on the ship, defeat them, find the Orb of Power, bring it to the center of the upper deck and activate it. Wait for Agrus and talk to him when pirates are defeated.

You did what the Great Winged One tell you!
First swing of wings - find captains of the ship. Little stinky bastards! They are on board somewhere.
Second swing - kill them!
Third swing - search the corpses and find the Orb of Power.
Fourth swing - bring the Orb to the deck. If someone intervenes - kill them.
Fifth swing - activate the artifact. Restore the power of Agrus!
Sixth swing - wait. Wait and watch how my brethren kill all pirates!
Seventh swing... watch Agrus coming back and talk to the Great Winged. Get the reward...
I wish I was in your place... But Agrus doesn't believe me...
Good bye, two-legged. We never see each other again. Do what you are told.

A-a-ah! Stupid is the one who thinks that revenge is better served cold!
Can't you see?! Fiery, hot revenge is much better, ha-ha!

You are waiting for the reward. I will keep my promise. You will get my Patronage.
Arrgh!
You can't even imagine how I hate you all!
Don't be afraid. It is just a fact. I hate everyone - People, Orcs, Elves, Gibberlings, Junes. Everyone! My hate is my power, my source of immortality. You will never understand it, as you will never understand what Patronage actually is!
Prepare yourself, as you will now get what you want.
After that, we are settled. I urge you to leave the island as soon as possible. If we meet again... I doubt we will have nice talks. Remember this!
Wait for Kuar the Sage to heal Argus the Callous and then speak with him.

Good job! All of the cursed coins are accounted for. Now we can revive Agrus! You see, part of Agrus' power is stored in these coins. If the pirates had held onto them enough, Agrus would have died and this allod would have disappeared.
Since you've saved Agrus I'm sure he shall grant you one favor. Follow me! I shall use the coins and the ancient amulet that Soliskar gave Agrus to revive him. After he is healed, you may speak with him.
Ha! The irony of this moment - my savior is one of my enemies! Your people still wander in the dark, naively thinking that you know everything, while all that you know is a lie!
Find William's Bag and the Ancient June Amulet and bring them to William de Vevre.

Thanks for killing those pirates! They probably would've killed me soon if it weren't for you. My name's William de Vevre and I'm a young Demon Hunter.
The Demon Hunters recently made an alliance with the draconids with the help of Soliskar the Wise. Together with our new allies, we are determined to defeat the demons.
Soliskar asked us to search for this forgotten temple and help Agrus the Callous. He's an old ally of Soliskar that is none other than the Great Dragon of this allod. He lives here with many draconids that help him tend the temple.
Agrus lies deep in the jungle beyond this endless stream of pirates. I'm afraid that I won't make it in time to help him, for you see, he's dying.
These pirates, on the other hand, continue to rise again and again even without Tensess' Gift. They killed the rest of the Demon Hunters that came with me, and now only I am left to complete our mission.
Time's is running out for Agrus. Please, search for my bag. I think the pirates hid it in one of their chests. It contains some very important things. Make sure to hurry - if you wait too long, the pirates will rise again before you return.

You found it! Oh, and here's the magical amulet that Soliskar gave to Agrus long ago. The pirates stole it from him, and I in turn stole it from them. They caught me right as I managed to slip it into my bag. With this back in my possession we should be able to save Agrus.
Find the Spark Catcher in Master's Citadel and receive three keys from the Mausoleum of Sparks.

Hungry for battle... I understand. When I was young and full of energy, I used to plunge into adventures, too. I know what it's like to be the winner...
Now I'm too old, and all I can is celebrating victories of new heroes and helping them to the best of my ability.
Do you want to attempt the Trial of Courage? Think twice! Mausoleum of Sparks is merciless to the weak. But those who are strong will find glory, honor and respect.
If you are sure, I'll give you three keys from the Mausoleum to take part in Trials.
Be aware, if you die during the Trial, you won't be able to re-enter until it's over. You and your friends will have to start over from the very beginning and spend another key.
One key is consumed at every attempt. Don't waste them!

Take these keys. I hope that they will lead you to triumph!
Gather your most experienced allies and fight back-to-back, covering each other. to prove your worth. Remember that a loner won't achieve much in the Trial of Courage. You should disregard your personal ambitions for the common sake, and act as a single entity.
Hello seeker... Are you looking for truth and power? Don't try to fool me, I can see the hunger for glory in your eyes. With Master's permission I'll help you to meet your dreams!

Trial of Bravery is your chance to earn glory in a ruthless battle, a chance to write your name into the list of Sarnaut's greatest heroes!
If you want to participate, gather your most faithful and experienced friends.
You will need the Shining Key to teleport into the Mausoleum of Sparks, an ancient structure created by Tep himself.
Tep used this Mausoleum for sacrifices. He extracted sparks from the bodies of his victims and placed them into his dreadful mechanisms to perform extraordinary magic!
The first mechanism can heal any wound after a spark absorption. The second one provides protection and speeds up the regeneration of magical powers. Using the third mechanism, you can feel a burst of energy embodied in a spark - your attacks will gain power and the energy will restore much quicker.
Our Master discovered the Mausoleum in the Astral depths and organized this Trial to find the strongest fighters.
Touch the stele in the center of the Mausoleum to start the Trial. Enemies will be coming in waves, you need to hold on as long as you can!
h: Ask about the Trial of Bravery

t: Meet with Elizaveta Rysina at Yasker's Tower.

Well then, hero. I don't know what exactly awaits you there, behind the gates of the Dead City, but I'm sure it will be another great feat and a new exciting adventure.
So it's time for you to return home. I can perceive it from the astral motions that something terrible has happened in your lands, and it will take all of your strength to defeat it. May Master's wisdom guide you!

Greetings, hero. You already took an oath and signed an NDA regarding government secrets, so let's skip the bureaucracy. I'll be straight with you. The Empire needs heroes now more than ever! I sense big trouble coming and the only ones who can deal with it are heroes, just like you.
Meet with Marianne de Ardeur in the church at the Novograd square.

Well then, hero. I don't know what exactly awaits you there, behind the gates of the Dead City, but I'm sure it will be another great feat and a new exciting adventure.
So it's time for you to return home. I can perceive it from the astral motions that something terrible has happened in your lands, and it will take all of your strength to defeat it. May Master's wisdom guide you!
Oh, there you are! Strange things happen in the world after Master fell in the battle against the heroes of Sarnaut... I'm afraid that in slaying him we pushed the world closer to the brink!
